items: **GIFT City banking-unit approvals:** HiWiPay (IFSCA in-principle, PSP), CAMS Investor Services (KYC agency), Artha Bharat (first physical gold fund), Punjab & Sind Bank (IBU licence).
**Paytm Europe:** payment institution licence in Luxembourg (eff. 2 July 2026).
**Federal Bank:** inaugural international issuer rating BBB-/Stable from S&P (first for the bank).
**EbixCash:** first AD-II entity with RBI perpetual licence; can process ₹25 lakh/transaction trade remittances.
**Delhivery Financial Services:** RBI Type-II NBFC-ND licence.
**Moody's affirms SBI & HDFC Bank:** Baa3 deposit rating (lowest investment grade tier).
**NPCI's UPI Meta (proposed):** faster checkout, saved UPI ID; PhonePe ~45% & GPay ~33% of UPI volumes.
**BoB data breach:** ~1TB leaked (employee email compromise, core banking unaffected); CERT-In is India's cyber regulator.
**Income-tax meal benefit:** tax-free limit ₹50→₹200/meal (effective 1 Apr 2026, CBDT), up to ₹1,05,600/year.
**NSE launches India's first domestic-benchmark Natural Gas Futures** (symbol NATGASIND, IGX Gujarat/Dahej benchmark).
**Axis Finance 'Drishti':** digital credit-decisioning platform (Axis Finance = Axis Bank subsidiary, est. 1995).

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Key regulatory thresholds, statutory dates, and institutional mandates in Quick Hits are critical for SBI PO Mains & RBI Grade B.
